scripts.dev: npm run build -w @susan/contracts && concurrently -n web,cms,booking -c green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @susan/web" "npm run dev -w @susan/cms" "npm run dev -w @susan/booking-api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @susan/contracts && npm run build -w @susan/web && npm run build -w @susan/cms && npm run build -w @susan/booking-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @susan/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
